title: Catamaran Catafjord Nordest 63

specs.Energy: Onan 7 kVA generator, 1,200 Wp solar panels, OPZV 1,220 Ah battery bank

highlights: Blue-water ketch catamaran designed by Lock Crowther
Large covered cockpit and protected central helm station
Watermaker, solar panels, generator and washing machine for long passages
description:
The Catafjord Nordest 63 is a 1996 long-range cruising catamaran built by Nordest Marine to the plans of Lock Crowther. Her ocean-going lines and ketch rig give her a fluid, balanced silhouette, resolutely blue-water oriented, with outstanding balance under sail in light breezes as in stronger conditions.

Constructed in epoxy-laminated strip-planked red cedar, she offers remarkable structural rigidity. The spacious covered cockpit is a true outdoor saloon, with a protected central helm station. Inside, the saloon combines warm wood finishes, natural light, a bar and a chart table, next to a fully equipped galley with a double refrigerator and a conventional oven.

Six cabins provide up to fourteen berths, with two bathrooms and a laundry area with a washing machine. Two Beta Marine 43 hp engines from 2017 (1,200 h), an Onan 7 kVA generator, 1,200 Wp of solar panels and a 100 L/h watermaker make her ready for extended cruising in independence.

Located in Tréguier, France. Price reduced to € 340,000 VAT included. Contact our team for the full specification and a viewing.
